PRUNE-CHANGELOG.summary: Removes changelog entries older than the given retention period.
PRUNE-CHANGELOG.complexity: O(S) where S is the number of segments. Entries are removed with range clears.

arguments.name: volume-name
arguments.summary: The name of the volume, in the format <kind>-shard-<id>.

arguments.name: retention-period
arguments.summary: Retention period in hours. Must be greater than zero.
